title: Gaussian law of a correlated endpoint
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\rho\in[-1,1]$. If $X,Y$ are independent standard Gaussian vectors in $\mathbb R^n$, then $\rho X+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,Y$ has the standard Gaussian product law on $\mathbb R^n$.
